name: skill-map-monorepo
description: skill-map monorepo — houses the public spec and the reference implementation.

scripts.validate: bun run --filter @skill-map/spec validate && bun run --filter @skill-map/cli validate && bun run --filter @skill-map/testkit validate && bun run --filter ui validate && bun run --filter skill-map-e2e validate && bun run --filter @skill-map/example-hello-world validate && bun run --filter @skill-map/web validate
scripts.release:version: changeset version && bun run --filter @skill-map/spec pin && bun run --filter @skill-map/spec spec && bun run --filter @skill-map/cli reference
